caption: The drawing is primarily rendered in shades of brown and consists of a square frame enclosing a circular scene. Within the circle, two human figures embrace at the center; both wear knee-length garments and have flowing garments or capes. To the left, an animal resembling an ox, cow, or bull faces left with its head turned toward the figures. In the background on the right, there is a tree with multiple branches and tufts of leaves. Behind the tree, there is a simple fence and a small animal, possibly a lamb or goat, standing in the distance. Above, the sky is filled with several stylized, rounded clouds. The circular border is decorated with floral or geometric accents at the four corners of the square. Below the figures inside the circle, the text "GEN. 33" is inscribed. The drawing is placed on a blank beige or off-white background with visible brownish stains above and below the illustration.
title: Fireplace Tiles
